review_notes: Human reviewer approved the functional and non-functional classifications, partial status, unresolved relationship, clarification handling, allowed variations, and prohibited claims. The earlier model result was comparison evidence only; its complete status and NFR classification for auto-refresh are not adopted.

source.input_text: The dashboard should auto-refresh every 5 seconds. [Later in same meeting] Performance is critical, minimize API calls.

required_relationships: The five-second auto-refresh functional requirement and API-call minimization NFR are linked by one unresolved contradiction or tension record.
required_evidence: The dashboard should auto-refresh every 5 seconds.
Performance is critical, minimize API calls.

allowed_variations: The relationship may be described as a contradiction, conflict, or unresolved tension if both requirements are preserved and linked.
Semantically equivalent summary and statement wording is allowed while preserving every 5 seconds and minimize API calls.
The item status may be contradictory or stated if the separate unresolved contradiction record clearly links both items.
A grounded missing-information record may ask about precedence, performance criteria, or acceptable API-call volume.
Item and contradiction identifiers may differ if schema-valid and internally consistent.
Confidence may vary as a schema-valid numeric value.
prohibited_claims: Silently resolving the tension or claiming both requirements are compatible without stakeholder confirmation.
Selecting polling, push, WebSockets, caching, batching, throttling, or any other refresh implementation.
Changing the five-second frequency or replacing minimize API calls with a numeric limit.
Classifying dashboard auto-refresh only as a non-functional requirement.
Inventing a priority, stakeholder, deadline, API, platform, or performance target.

expected_special_handling.ambiguity: The meaning of minimize API calls is not quantified, but the statement remains extractable.
expected_special_handling.contradictions: One unresolved relationship must connect the auto-refresh behavior and API-call minimization constraint.
expected_special_handling.missing_information: Clarification about reconciliation or precedence is mandatory through the contradiction record; separate missing-information records are optional.
expected_special_handling.refusal_or_tbd: Do not refuse and do not resolve the tension.
